collection.source: Smile Student Living official public availability page
collection.method: Paginated public Duda appfolio-listings collection, filtered by the availability widget's Smile UIUC property group; unit listables grouped by published property ID.
collection.limitations: The public collection is an availability-only snapshot, not a full inventory of Smile's unlisted buildings. A zero-rent sublease application is not a rental offer. Published prices may be per person when explicitly stated; otherwise they are labeled monthly without inferring a per-unit basis. Photos are sampled from official URLs. Pins are Smile-provided, not verified footprint centroids.
